list.import_error_json: This file is not a chat export (it is not JSON).
list.import_error_schema: This file is not a Starpi chat export.
list.import_error_empty: This chat export has no messages.
list.import_error_invalid: This chat export is damaged and was not imported.
list.import_error_too_large: This file is too large to import.
list.import_error_store: The chat could not be stored on this device.
list.empty: No chats yet. Your conversations appear here.
list.load_failed: The chats on this device could not be loaded.
list.unarchived: Chat moved back to the list
list.delete_confirm: Delete “{title}”? Its messages are removed from this browser. This cannot be undone.
list.delete_answering: An answer is still being written in this chat. Wait for it or stop it, then delete the chat.
list.delete_partial: Deleted in this browser, but messages an earlier version kept on the server could not be deleted right now. Delete the chat history in Settings when you are online.
list.action_failed: That did not work. Please try again.
list.delete_confirm_synced: Delete “{title}”? Sync is on: the chat is removed from this browser, from the synced copy and from your other browsers when they sync next. This cannot be undone.
list.delete_current_confirm_synced: Delete this chat? Sync is on: it is removed from this browser, from the synced copy and from your other browsers when they sync next. This cannot be undone.
list.delete_history_confirm_synced: Delete every chat stored in this browser? Sync is on: the deletion also reaches the synced copy and your other browsers when they sync next. This cannot be undone.
list.delete_partial_synced: Deleted in this browser. The synced copy and your other browsers follow with the next sync; if another browser added messages to this chat meanwhile, it comes back.
list.delete_history_partial_synced: The chats in this browser were deleted. The synced copy and your other browsers follow with the next sync; a chat another browser added messages to meanwhile comes back.
